steps.say: Give every service its own key. Make them at random, or bring your own.
Replace one key, to see its secrets sealed again under the new one and the old key destroyed.
Add someone. Press New contact and give them a name or an address.
Open a contact and change a detail, like their phone or company.
Connect your Google account.
Copy a file from Google to your Drive.
In My Drive, press To Google on a file.
Make an address for something you do not fully trust, like a shop's sign-up form.
Turn it off. Mail to that address is now refused, and your real address stays private.
Add a person. They get their own mailbox, Drive and calendar on your domain.
Edit someone to reset a password or change how much storage they have.
Make a team. It gets its own address that reaches everyone in it.
Add a person and put them on the team.
Edit someone and set how much storage they can use.
Make an organisation. Give it its domains, the person who runs it, and how many people and how much storage it can have.
Publish the DNS records listed below at your DNS provider, then press Check again.
Add a mailbox for someone on your team.
Send your first message from webmail.
Turn on two-factor sign-in for your own account.
Make a team. It gets its own address that reaches everyone on it.
Tick the people who belong on it.
Choose the AI service. A model on your own machines keeps every question here.
Test the connection to see it answer.
Add an event. Press New event, or a day on the calendar.
Open your event and change something about it.
Add a guest's address to an event. They get an email invitation.
Upload a file. Press Upload, or drop a file on this page.
Make a folder to keep things together.
Move a file into your folder with its Move button.
Download a file to this device.
Make an alert. Pick a number to watch, the line it should not cross, and where to send the warning.
Press Check now to see it work without waiting five minutes.
Start a new document and give it a title.
Write something. It saves by itself as you type.
Download a copy, or print it to PDF.
